messages:
eva: Quick ping — opened PR #472 to tidy the Node quickstart and add an embedding sample. can someone take a look? https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/472 :wave:
ben: :eyes: I'll take a pass in ~1h. is this changing the streaming example or just docs/usage?
eva: Just docs/usage — clarifies auth, adds a tiny embedding snippet, and a yarn/npm note. no streaming changes.
carol: Left one inline about the env var name. prefer REDWOOD_API_KEY over REDWOOD_KEY to be consistent with other guides.
eva: good catch @carol — will update. also added a short line about rate limits: 'responses may be truncated under high-throughput; enable batching for cost savings' — ok phrasing?
alice: quick nit: examples/embedding-sample.js uses const model = 'open-embedding-1' — maybe link to model catalog or use 'redwood/open-embedding-1' so users find the exact model; otherwise fine.
ben: pushed a tiny suggestion: replace the model string with a link placeholder to /docs/models and removed an extra semicolon in the snippet. not blocking.
docs-bot: CI: docs build queued (job #112)
ci-bot: linter: markdownlint flagged 1 warning in quickstarts/node.md -> line 42: MD029 ordered list item indent
eva: fixed the indent + updated the PR (force-pushed).
carol: LGTM after the env var rename, leaving approval.
ben: approved — left one suggestion but it's optional.
alice: :thumbsup: approved. can someone merge once CI is green?
ci-bot: CI: all checks green ✅ (build #112 succeeded)
eva: thanks all, merging now. i'll post when the site deploys.
deploy-bot: deploy: docs site updated at https://docs.redwood.inference/quickstarts/node (build 202) :rocket:
